formal_statement: ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∀ p : Polynomial ℕ, ∃ (m N : ℕ) (G : PEqualNP.Expanders.BipGraph m N), N < m ∧ ∀ π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinKLine (PEqualNP.Expanders.GEdge G)), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsLinKRefutation k (PEqualNP.Expanders.funGraphPHP G) π → p.eval (Fintype.card (PEqualNP.Expanders.GEdge G)) < π.length
plain_statement: For every k >= 1 and polynomial p there is a bipartite graph G with more pigeons than holes such that every refutation of the functional pigeonhole formula on G in our system Res(k,+) (lines: disjunctions of conjunctions of at most k linear equations mod 2; cut on a term, and-introduction, termwise weakening) has more than p(v) lines, v the number of variables. Conjecture. Route: the proof of L-pcx-042 with inputs of degree k, on L-pcx-049. Our own system, attributed to no source; by the literature desk neither 2026 report reaches k >= 2, an unread manuscript may.
title: TARGET: resolution over conjunctions of at most k parity equations (termwise weakening) is not polynomially bounded on functional pigeonhole, for every k
